cloudStepChecking: Connecting to the environment and checking the runtime
environmentRepaired: Environment fixed; continuing with the earlier messages
sandboxReplaced: Preparing the environment failed; preparing it again
sandboxLost: The environment stopped answering and was replaced: pushed commits come along, and everything else on it is gone
sandboxReleased: The environment was released after {minutes} minutes without activity. The next message starts a new one, and work pushed and backed up at the end of each run comes along.
sandboxReleasedNoCredits: Credits ran out, so the environment was released. Once there are credits again, the next message starts a new one, and work pushed and backed up at the end of each run comes along.
sandboxReleasedDiskFull: The computer's disk was nearly full and this environment held the most of it ({gb} GB, {files} files, mostly under {where}), so it was released. The next message starts a new one, and work pushed and backed up at the end of each run comes along. Delete temporary files once you are done with them, so they do not pile up.
sandboxReleasedOverBudget: This environment held more of the disk than one environment may ({gb} GB, {files} files, mostly under {where}; the limit is {limit_gb} GB and {limit_files} files), so it was released. The next message starts a new one, and work pushed and backed up at the end of each run comes along. Delete temporary files once you are done with them, so they do not pile up.
sandboxArchivesKept: Archives left by this conversation's earlier environments are kept until {date} and then deleted. To get files back from them, contact the platform administrator.
cloudVmReplaced: Preparing the cloud VM failed; preparing it again
cloudVmReleasedIdle: The cloud VM was idle for {minutes} minutes. Its changes were pushed to their branches and it was released; the next message prepares a new one.
cloudHostGivenUp: Cloud host {host} was given up: {lost} running environments were lost with it, and {replaced} environments being prepared moved to another host
executorInstallDownloading: Installing the AI teammate's runtime on “{device}”: {done} / {total} MB downloaded
executorInstallDone: Installed the AI teammate's runtime on “{device}”
executorInstallStopped: Installing the AI teammate's runtime on “{device}” stopped at {done} / {total} MB. The download continues the next time the AI teammate uses this computer
executorInstallFailed: Installing the AI teammate's runtime on “{device}” failed
